summary: A professional signs up for public work and waits while colleagues receive their postings.
realLife: NIH physician Robert Perlman volunteered for the desegregation work but never received a field assignment.
gates: The agency assigns volunteers to fieldwork.
inGame: needs: a volunteer roster distinguishing training, availability and actual deployment.

turns.what: The coordinator assigns the volunteer to an inspection pair.
turns.pulledBy: A trained partner and an uncovered facility are both available.
turns.writesBack: The roster names a site and visit date.

turns.what: The volunteer reviews case files at headquarters.
turns.pulledBy: Field positions are filled but inspection reports await review.
turns.writesBack: The service record shows a desk assignment.
